subject: Discovery Recap - Senior Stakeholder Alignment & Procurement Path
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Michael Rowe <m.rowe@novacorp.com>, Elaine Silva <elaine@novacorp.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-20T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Recap: Discovery — Senior Stakeholder Alignment & Next Steps

Hi Michael / Elaine —

Thanks again for your time this morning. Quick recap from our discovery and suggested next steps so we have alignment with your exec team. I captured what we heard and what we propose to move the discussion to procurement and legal. Please reply with any corrections.

Key pain points we heard:
- High per-token cost on current gen LLM endpoints plus unpredictable latency at peak (affects real-time agents).
- Strict data isolation and audit requirements for customer PII & logs (must be retained 7 years; audit access by Nova internal audit).
- Procurement needs a clear path (PO + SOW or enterprise contract) and an estimate for FY27 budget planning.

Business goals / success metrics:
1) Reduce inference unit cost by ~40% on batch/embedding workloads within 6 months.
2) Achieve p99 latency < 300ms for 95% of low-latency routes.
3) Maintain end-to-end auditability for customer requests (retention, redaction markers).

Risks called out by your team:
- Legal needs security evidence (SOC 2 + network diagram + KMS integration notes).
- Procurement timeline: month-end PO cycle Nov 12; any contract must be reviewed by Nov 5 to make that window.

Proposed path / owners:
- Exec sponsor: Elaine Silva (confirmed on call) — for budget and procurement escalation.
- Technical owner: Michael Rowe — will coordinate security questionnaire and technical deep-dive.
- Redwood owners: Laura Bennett (executive escalation + terms), Sergio Alvarez (deal owner / SOW), me — discovery + pilot coordination.

Immediate next steps (action items):
1) I will share the discovery map and a 1-page executive brief by EOD (attached).
2) Michael / Elaine to confirm procurement preferred path (SOW + PO vs. enterprise agreement) and if legal should receive a redline first. Please reply by COB Wed 10/22.
3) Schedule 30-min exec briefing with Elaine + VP of Platform for Nov 3 — Laura to lead and bring SLA/pricing options.
4) Michael to provide security questionnaire contact & initial list of must-have attestations by 10/23.

Attachments: NOVA-DISCOVERY-MAP.pdf (sketch), redwood-draft-map.xlsx (MVP scope), Nova-MAP-v1.pptx (exec brief)

If that looks right, I'll open a mutual action plan and draft a procurement timeline to share with your legal and procurement teams.

Thanks,
Dylan

Thanks for the clear summary. A few clarifications from our side:

- Procurement: We typically prefer SOW + PO for pilots, but enterprise agreement is possible if we consolidate multiple pilots. Procurement and legal will need a draft SOW and an estimated spend range for FY27.

Folks —

Thanks Dylan and Mike — adding a short exec-level framing and mitigation approach so Nova leadership has talking points. Happy to join the Nov 3 briefing; I've penciled it in.

Exec framing (2 minutes):
- Value: Move Nova from variable, black-box endpoints to a predictable inference platform that reduces unit costs (target 35–45% / token) and provides SLA-backed latency and routing controls for critical customer flows.
- Risk mitigation: Redwood will provide SOC 2 Type II evidence, a high-level network diagram (attached link), and a proposed KMS integration pattern. We propose a limited pilot (3–6 months) scoped to user-facing agent flows with a clearly defined rollback plan.

Procurement recommendation (path to production):
1) Mutual Action Plan (MAP) + SOW (Pilot scope & KPIs) — sign PO for pilot.
2) Post-pilot evaluation (30 days) with ops metrics & cost report.
3) If KPIs met, negotiate enterprise contract with reserved capacity or dedicated pool.

Deliverables & owners / timelines:
- Draft SOW + MAP: Sergio (redwood) — draft by 10/22.
- SOC 2 + network diagram + KMS notes: Dylan / Redwood Security — 10/23.
- Exec briefing materials (one-pager + pricing bands): Laura — 10/27.

Legal / redlines: I recommend we put a non-negotiable block for audit access and data-retention SLAs in the SOW and offer a standard limited indemnity. If Nova legal wants to propose alternate language, we'll coordinate with our counsel.

Link to draft brief and shared folder: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/Nova/DiscoveryMap

Laura Bennett
VP, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
